Die Energiewende ist eines der größten Infrastrukturprojekte unserer Zeit. Damit der Strom fließen kann, brauchen wir Menschen, die den Überblick behalten, wenn es komplex wird. Wir suchen einen versierten Terminplaner (m/w/d) , der unsere Wind-Stromtrassen-Projekte mit Oracle Primavera P6 steuert und die Fäden zwischen Planung, Bau und Ressourcenmanagement zusammenhält.
Werde Teil unseres motivierten Teams und trage gemeinsam mit uns einen Teil zur Energiewende bei.
Bewirb Dich noch heute und komm in unser Team!
Aufgaben
Du erstellst, aktualisierst und überwachst komplexe Rahmenterminpläne für den Bau von Stromtrassen unter Einsatz von Oracle Primavera P6
Du koordinierst den Einsatz von internen und externen Kapazitäten und stellst sicher, dass Personal und Material zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort sind
Du analysierst den Projektstatus (Soll-Ist-Vergleich), identifizierst kritische Pfade und leitest proaktiv Gegenmaßnahmen bei Abweichungen ein
Du arbeitest eng mit der Projektleitung, den Bauleitern und externen Dienstleistern zusammen, um Milestones termingerecht zu erreichen
Du nutzt Primavera P6 für „Was-wäre-wenn“-Szenarien, um Risiken frühzeitig zu minimieren
Qualifikation
Du beherrscht Oracle Primavera P6 sicher (einschließlich Ressourcenplanung, Kostenüberwachung und kritischer Pfad-Analyse)
Du bringst ein abgeschlossenes technisches (z. B. in Ingenieurwissenschaft, Elektrotechnik oder Bauingenieurwesen) oder kaufmännisches Studium mit (z.B. Betriebswirtschaft oder Wirtschaftsing.) oder besitzt eine vergleichbare Ausbildung/Studium
Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Planung von komplexen (Infrastruktur-)Großprojekten gesammelt
Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (mindestens C1-Niveau), um Abstimmungen mit Behörden und Bauteams reibungslos zu führen
Du behälst auch bei engen und komplexen Deadlines einen kühlen Kopf
Kenntnisse im Bereich Windenergie oder Trassenbau sind ein Vorteil, aber kein Muss – wir legen mehr Wert auf Ihre methodische Stärke in der Planung

What You'll Do Reporting to the Director of Project Services, the Senior Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing project schedules across the full project lifecycle, from preconstruction and bid development through baseline establishment and execution support. This is not a schedule maintenance role.

We are seeking someone who can build credible, logic-driven schedules grounded in real construction means and methods, actively support project teams through planning and execution, and contribute to strengthening scheduling standards, templates, and repeatable processes across the organization.

The ideal candidate brings advanced Primavera P6 expertise, strong construction acumen, and experience supporting complex, high-value, high-risk EPC projects.

This role is well-suited for an individual who wants to go beyond managing individual project schedules and play a meaningful role in evolving and maturing the organization’s scheduling function.

Key Responsibilities The responsibilities include, but may not be limited to: Independently develop and own preliminary project schedules for bids, proposals, and preconstruction efforts based on available scope, drawings, client requirements, execution assumptions, and commercial milestones.

Work closely with estimating, engineering, procurement, project management, and operations teams to translate construction strategy, sequencing, milestones, constraints, and resource requirements into practical and executable schedules.

Provide scheduling leadership during the transition from estimate to execution, including schedule handoff documentation, logic assumptions, basis of schedule information, and planning support for project teams.

Develop, maintain, and control contract, baseline, and execution schedules that align with project scope, contractual milestones, procurement strategy, engineering deliverables, and field execution plans.

Independently manage scheduling activities for assigned projects, particularly larger, more complex, or higher risk EPC projects where schedule quality, integration, and forecasting are critical.

Establish an effective schedule update process with project teams and ensure schedules accurately reflect progress, remaining work, current constraints, resource planning, and forecast completion dates.

Perform detailed schedule analysis to identify critical and near critical path impacts, sequencing concerns, float erosion, long lead risks, emerging delays, and opportunities to improve execution. Proactively communicate schedule risks and recommended actions to project leadership, providing clear analysis that supports timely decision making.

Lead schedule change evaluation and work with project teams to develop mitigation, acceleration, or recovery plans. Incorporate approved changes in scope, sequencing, and execution strategy into the schedule.

Coordinate with procurement, engineering, subcontractors, project management, and field operations to ensure schedules reflect current deliverables, commitments, constraints, and actual project conditions. Prepare schedule reports, narratives, dashboards, presentations, and executive level summaries for internal stakeholders and clients.

Lead the development and continuous improvement of scheduling templates, procedures, standards, governance, and repeatable processes, primarily within Primavera P6. Establish consistent expectations for schedule development, maintenance, analysis, reporting, change control, and project team participation across the organization.

Serve as a scheduling subject matter expert and provide practical guidance, coaching, and support to project managers, project controls personnel, and operational teams. Identify opportunities to improve scheduling tools, data quality, reporting, and integration with broader project controls and project management processes.

Help build a scalable scheduling function that provides greater consistency, structure, accountability, and discipline across the organization. Support the future growth of the scheduling team through the development of standard work practices, training materials, onboarding resources, and quality review processes.

Demonstrate the leadership capability and organizational perspective required to assume broader responsibility within the scheduling function as the team grows. Additional Information As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to complete pre-employment screening including professional reference checks and a criminal record check.

The Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and monitoring project schedules to ensure construction projects are delivered on time and within budget. This role collaborates closely with project managers, preconstruction managers, estimators, superintendents, subcontractors, and clients to coordinate timelines, monitor progress, identify risks, and recommend corrective actions when necessary. This role is based in St. Thomas, USVI and projected to start in October 2026.

Schedule Development & Planning
Develop detailed baseline schedules using tools such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or similar scheduling software, covering all project phases from RFP/Project Launch through Substantial Completion and Final Turnover.
Create Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and define project activities, durations, and sequencing.
Establish logic-driven critical path (CPM) and identify schedule constraints.
Resource load schedules with quantities, labor, and cost data when required.
Prepare schedule narratives documenting assumptions and methodologies.
Collaborate with project managers, preconstruction managers, field teams and estimators during both preconstruction and construction phases.
Schedule Monitoring & Control
Conduct site visits to assess and document construction progress.
Update schedules regularly to reflect actual progress.
Perform critical path analysis and identify variances.
Develop recovery schedules when delays occur.
Perform Time Impact Analyses (TIA) to assess the effects of change orders and scope modifications.
Means & Methods – Non-Mandatory
Define construction means and methods required to achieve schedule objectives.
Develop site logistics and Maintenance of Traffic (MOT) plans in 2D or 3D formats.
Reporting & Communication
Prepare and distribute schedule reports, dashboards, executive summaries, and look-ahead schedules.
Present schedule status updates to internal stakeholders and clients.
Provide scheduling input for executive reports and owner meetings.
Maintain documentation to support claims and delay analyses when required.
Risk Management
Identify schedule-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
Conduct what-if scenario analysis to evaluate alternative approaches.
Support dispute resolution efforts through detailed time impact analysis.
Collaboration
Coordinate with project management, engineering, procurement, and subcontractors to ensure schedule alignment.
Support resource planning and labor forecasting efforts.
Ensure alignment between field operations and master project schedules.

3 to 5 years of experience in construction scheduling or project controls preferably within the US, South Florida or the Caribbean.
Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, or related field (preferred).
Experience on commercial, infrastructure or residential projects.
Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project.
Strong understanding of construction sequencing means and methods.
Solid knowledge of Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling.
Familiarity with cost control, earned value management (EVM) principles
Ability to use construction resources data to validate productivity rates and activity durations
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (including Excel), Power BI, Bluebeam is a must.
Working knowledge of (or willingness to learn) BIM, Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, cmBuilder and Synchro 4D.
Ability to interpret contract documents, drawings, specifications, and scopes of work.
Ability to perform quick quantity take-offs for scheduling purposes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
